extra: The state-machine confirmation (Handoff 9.5): every game puts one of the two generation-2 survivors against the pure T2_sieger, 80 games each, no other opposition. This is the head-to-head the tournament batches could not give.

Judge on each machine's win rate against the sieger with its Wilson interval: a lower bound above 50 confirms that a laning opening beats sieging from round 1; a point estimate near 50 says the two generations' Bradley-Terry edge was opposition mix. Either way, this settles the field champion balance is measured in.
